statement.document_title: Elon Musk’s preposterous and possibly harmful claim about robotic surgery

from_speaker: by the end of the decade
our_interpretation: Read 'anytime soon' against the immediately following bet, giving a deadline of December 31, 2029. The sentence alone supplies no precise deadline.
The ordinary reading is autonomous surgical competence superior to leading human surgeons across a representative range of procedures, including patient outcomes and handling complications.
A successful laboratory task, surgeon-controlled robot, or regulatory approval alone would not establish this superiority.
'Absurd' expresses Marcus's confidence; the assessable proposition is his negative forecast.
criteria.support_condition: At the deadline, sufficiently comprehensive clinical and regulatory evidence shows that robots have not attained the specified superiority.
criteria.contradiction_condition: By the deadline, credible comparative clinical evidence establishes autonomous robotic superiority to leading human surgeons across a representative range of surgery.
